etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English excitement, from Old French excitement, equivalent to excite +‎ -ment.

definitions.definition: (uncountable) The state of being excited (emotionally aroused).

quote.citation: 1835, Edgar Allan Poe, The unparalleled adventure of one Hans Pfaal:
quote.text: By late accounts from Rotterdam, that city seems to be in a high state of philosophical excitement.
